items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Not Pete Fountain. ... Pete Fountain. Yeah, uh-huh. ... Pete Fountain plays a lot of the tunes that you heard in those days, huh? ... We had a lot of them pieces he plays, you know.

ctx.x: Well, now, uh, I wanted to ask you about, uh, in your own life, what's the first music you remember? Either singing or a band playing or piano or what have you?

Well, uh, we used to have, uh, piano playing. We had, uh, we had a fellow who used to play piano, go all over with us. His name was, uh, Sonny Swarm. Oh, I've heard of him. He used to play piano, you know. I have a lot of them blues. I know him when I hear him, because I heard, I hear him every once in a while, I hear him on that little radio we have. And, uh, this fellow there that's gone to California, I think, or somewhere, uh, from that great clarinet player from here. Luzanne knew him good from when she was…
